name: Twin Minarets
summary: A sculptural central dome is held in balance by two rose-colored minarets.
why: The tall central dome, broad prayer hall, and two minarets make a complete mosque silhouette. A pointed entrance opens through the hall. Symmetry gives the mark a formal sense of balance and devotion.
risk: The twin-minaret mosque is a familiar motif. Its distinct character comes from the stepped architecture, compact proportions, and plum-and-rose palette.
sub1: Balance and a recognizable mosque skyline
reasonToChoose: You want an immediately recognizable mosque with a composed, symmetrical identity.

palette.name: TWIN MINARETS / PLUM + PORCELAIN + DUSTY ROSE
